crossRefs.note: Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you.
Praise waits for you, God, in Zion. Vows shall be performed to you.
I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,
which my lips promised, and my mouth spoke, when I was in distress.
I will pay my vows to Yahweh, yes, in the presence of all his people.
I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.
When the king lived in his house, and Yahweh had given him rest from all his enemies all around,
until I find out a place for Yahweh, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”
Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge.
The Mighty One, God, Yahweh, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.
Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in Yahweh, his God:
who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;
